target_customer: Individuals and teams who want one cloud desktop workspace with a built-in AI agent for code, ops and marketing
problem: Knowledge workers juggle separate tools for AI chat, vibe coding, files, browser and terminal, and agents lack a persistent computer to work in.
business_model: Subscription for individual and team plans (prices not captured)
product_category: Cloud desktop OS and AI agent workspace

founders.name: Sam Park
education: Harvard, dropped out (per a Lune launch post on the YC page; names match but the page does not explicitly tie it)

founders.name: Josh Park
founders.background_notes: Brother of Sam Park per the Lune launch post.

competitors.name: Narada AI
competitors.what: Enterprise agent that operates across workplace apps, compared by TechCrunch to Anthropic computer use

technical_complexity.rationale: Persistent multi-user Linux desktops streamed to web and mobile with an OS-integrated agent are demanding infrastructure for a two person team.

defensibility.rationale: Persistent files and agent context create some lock-in, but cloud desktops and agent frameworks are widely available and big labs shipped similar features.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: OpenAI later shipped cloud workspace agents (2026 reports); no acquisition of Endstack found.

market_need_then: Agentic computer use appeared in late 2024 (Anthropic computer use), raising interest in giving agents a full desktop.

branding.domain_note: Operates on endstack.com; no history found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Bold and practical: 'The most capable AI workspace', no setup, no learning curve

rebrands.why: Not stated; Dealroom says Endstack was formerly Lune and reports a public workspace launch in 2026-08

brand_strength.rationale: Very early company with no press about the brand; the Lune to Endstack rename suggests the brand was still forming.

pivots.to: Endstack cloud desktop workspace for humans and agents

outcome_analysis: Endstack is a two person Fall 2024 company that appears to have repositioned from the Lune brand to a cloud desktop and agent workspace. No priced rounds, customers or outcome events are public, so the story is unresolved. It sits in a crowded category where model labs ship adjacent agent products.
notes: Funding seen only on aggregators and unverified: about $500K pre-seed (VCBacked, EveryDev), Dealroom seed entries of $125k and $500k, and StartupHub claiming $3M with a Series A that no other source supports. HQ conflict: YC says Los Angeles, Dealroom says San Francisco. Pivot date unknown. The recorded pre-seed rests on a single database (VCBacked, Sep 2024). Another profile for Lune AI dates it Dec 2024 and adds Pioneer Fund. Dealroom 125K and 500K entries and the StartupHub 3M Series A claim are not recorded.
